not_liked_song_ids=[310,31,173,247,12,304,202]
existing_review_by_song={247:294,12:295}

results=[]
# updates
for sid,review_id in existing_review_by_song.items():
    resp=apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=review_id,access_token=access_token,rating=1)
    print('update',sid,review_id,'resp',resp)
    results.append(('update',sid,review_id,resp))

# create for songs without existing review
for sid in not_liked_song_ids:
    if sid in existing_review_by_song:
        continue
    resp=apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=sid,rating=1,access_token=access_token)
    print('create',sid,'resp',resp)
    results.append(('create',sid,resp.get('song_review_id'),resp))

print('done actions, count',len(results))
